<h1 class="research-title">Research</h1>

My research interests lie primarily in the areas of computational communication science, political communication, and user behavior on social media platforms. Below is a list of my publications, including peer-reviewed journal articles, book chapters, and preprints, as well as conference presentations and invited talks.
:::

## Publications

```{r load-publications, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
source("scripts/get_pubs.R")

doi_file <- "pubs/dois.txt" 

# Grouped by type (journal articles, book chapters, preprints); set group_by_year = TRUE for year subheadings
cat(generate_publication_list_from_file(doi_file_path = doi_file, group_by_year = FALSE))
```
